tagline: 柯达玩具相机，1988 年发布
description: 柯达于1988年推出的玩具相机。

specs.英文简介:
The My First Camera is a very basic fixed-focus 110 film camera by Kodak from circa late-1980s.[http://kodak.3106.net/index.php?p=211&cam=1039 My First Camera] at [http://kodak.3106.net/index.php Kodak Classics] Its name suggests it was intended for children, 

Kodak released several very similar cameras under different names, such as Kodak Gimini, Kodak Winner, Kodak Kids Camera, Kodak Trimlite I
